definitions.explanation: The fourth of the five ranks of the Japanese peerage ({華族|かぞく}) set up in 1884 and abolished in 1947, below count ({伯爵|はくしゃく}) and above baron ({男爵|だんしゃく}). Also used to translate the European title.

examples.english: He was born into a viscount's family.

examples.japanese: ⟦{明治|めいじ}{時代|じだい}→明治時代：28080_meijijidai⟧、⟦{功績|こうせき}→功績：04143_kouseki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{子爵|ししゃく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{授|さず}けられた→授ける：10350_sazukeru⟧。
examples.english: In the Meiji era he was made a viscount for his services.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{戦後|せんご}→戦後：12853_sengo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{没落|ぼつらく}→没落：15873_botsuraku⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧いく{子爵|ししゃく}{家|け}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人々|ひとびと}→人々：03141_hitobito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|えが}いている→描く：02013_egaku⟧。
examples.english: The novel depicts a viscount's family as it declines after the war.

notes:
The five ranks, from highest: ⟦{公爵|こうしゃく}→公爵：17797_koushaku⟧ (prince or duke), ⟦{侯爵|こうしゃく}→侯爵：32023_koushaku⟧ (marquis), ⟦{伯爵|はくしゃく}→伯爵：11721_hakushaku⟧ (count), {子爵|ししゃく} (viscount), ⟦{男爵|だんしゃく}→男爵：13585_danshaku⟧ (baron).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {子爵|ししゃく}{家|け}: a viscount's family
- {子爵|ししゃく}⟦{夫人|ふじん}→夫人：03597_fujin⟧: viscountess (wife of a viscount)
- {子爵|ししゃく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{授|さず}けられる→授ける：10350_sazukeru⟧: to be made a viscount
